name: 星核旅人 · 星核仓首版（32×32 侧视像素分层）
status: prototype first pass, pending user visual feedback; not final art

design.origin: center of the 32×32 bay; all layers share the same origin
design.base: white stone pedestal with grey-blue shading and thickness, starting at image y=24
design.glass: pale-cyan bell dome: semicircular cap (outer radius 15) plus short vertical walls to y=24
design.glass_interior: fully transparent over the core's 16×16 rect; only rim, seal and outside-core reflections are opaque
design.core: existing 16×16 purple star core at (0,0), image rect x=8..23, y=8..23
design.gold_runes: small hollow diamond with a center dot plus one dim stud on the pedestal front
design.lock_marker: 4×3 code-drawn gold padlock on the pedestal; not baked into any PNG
design.dome_geometry_note: A strict semicircle cannot enclose a 16×16 core above an 8px pedestal in 32×32: at the core top (16px above the base) a 32-wide strict semicircle would be only the apex, and its radius is just 16. The 32×32 bay therefore uses a semicircular cap plus short vertical walls; the core is not scaled and the pedestal is not redesigned. If a strict semicircle is mandatory, widen the canvas to about 44×32 (46×32 with margin), not merely 32×40: a taller 32×40 can host a half-ellipse/bell, not a strict semicircle.

source.core_attribution: Free Shiny Gem "Round" by Frakassets, CC BY 4.0, https://frakassets.itch.io/free-shiny-gem-round
source.note: The existing purple core is only composited in the review image, the Godot scene, and the engine preview screenshot; no existing asset was modified.

review_image.note: Local nearest-neighbour composite review, not a Godot engine capture. Checkerboard, labels and the code-lock replica are not part of any exported PNG. The 1x player idle crop is the project's existing character art, used only for scale; its license is still unknown, so this sheet is for internal review only.

integration.core_state: LOCKED (purple); the original StarCoreVisual bottom-right badge is disabled by the bay scene
integration.occupied_export: occupied: bool (default true) hides/shows the existing core and the code lock marker; pure display, no bay logic
integration.not_included: no opening animation, no storage/retrieval interaction, no collision, no suction, no default main scene wiring, no formal level layout

notes: All three exported PNGs are 32×32, same origin. The empty composite is base+glass only; no core is baked in.
The glass layer is genuinely transparent over the full 16×16 core rect, verified by alpha sampling.
The review image's occupied composite is a reference only; the game scene layers base, the existing core, and glass separately.
This is a first-pass look-dev asset pending user visual feedback, not final art.
